install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; SYS_PY=$(PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" command -v python3); if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv "$HOME/.venv" --python "$SYS_PY" --allow-existing && uv pip install --python "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" -r requirements.txt "tiktoken>=0.7.0"; else [ -x "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" ] || "$SYS_PY" -m venv "$HOME/.venv"; "$HOME/.venv/bin/pip" install --no-input -r requirements.txt "tiktoken>=0.7.0"; fi; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
